people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.
translations.bsb: And after they had come down from the high place into the city, Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof of his house.
translations.kjv: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.
translations.asv: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, he communed with Saul upon the housetop.
